text:
Roe v. Wade is controversial because it settled a deeply contested moral question, when life or personhood begins and how to weigh it against a woman's autonomy, by declaring a nationwide constitutional right to abortion. Critics, including some legal scholars who support abortion rights, argued that the right to privacy it rested on was weakly grounded and took the issue away from democratic debate, while supporters saw it as protecting reproductive freedom and health. The team note is inaccurate: Blackmun's opinion discussed medical history and positions of the AMA and other medical bodies, and medical amicus briefs were filed, so the controversy was not over a lack of medical input.

CONFIDENCE: 88
